name: better-visual-studio-code-project-manager
title: Better Visual Studio Code
description: Search and open projects from Visual Studio Code Project Manager
author: jakeobsen

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Project Manager
commands.description: Search projects from projects.json and open them.

preferences.name: groupProjectsByTag
preferences.title: Group Projects...
preferences.label: by tag
preferences.description: Groups projects by tag instead of just showing

preferences.name: hideProjectsNotEnabled
preferences.label: not enabled
preferences.description: Hide projects with enabled set to false

preferences.name: projectManagerDataPath
preferences.title: Projects Location
preferences.description: Directory containing projects.json (and optional projects_cache_*.json). Leave blank to use VSCode Project Manager's default storage location.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App Path
preferences.description: Path to the terminal app (Lazygit launcher assumes Terminal.app)

preferences.name: gitClientApp
preferences.title: Git Client Command
preferences.description: Shell command run inside the terminal at the project root (e.g. lazygit, gitui, tig)
